Booths

The exhibit halls are open Sunday to Wednesday. Build your route with ＋, then mark each booth as visited and note who you met and what was new.

McCormick Place

How to read room numbers

The letter is the building and the first digit is the level. S403A = South, level 4. E450B = Lakeside, level 4. N226 = North, level 2.

Estimated walking time (minutes)

From / toNorthSouthWestLakeside

Normal pace, including escalators. Add 3–5 min at peak times. Same building: ~2 min on the same level, ~5 min between levels.

Key spots

  • Learning Center (posters, Education Exhibits, Learning Center Theaters): Lakeside Center East, level 3.
  • AI Showcase e AI Theater: South Hall A, level 3 (booths 5536 and 4729).
  • Technical exhibits: North Hall B and South Hall A.
  • Grand Concourse (level 2.5) connects North and South; the skybridge to Lakeside starts there.

Unofficial guide, built by colleagues, not affiliated with RSNA. It uses only public event information: the session catalog, speaker list and exhibitor list published by RSNA.
